content:
LAREDO — A 50-year-old woman was booked into the Webb County Jail early Saturday morning on a state jail felony theft charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Minerva San Juanita Lopez was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 12:59 a.m. The booking record lists the charge as theft of property valued at less than $2,500 with two or more prior convictions — a state jail felony under Texas law — and bond was set at $30,000.

The booking record does not list an arresting agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
